result.title: SIFR: Stable Signed Flow Reinforcement
result.summary: Reward-based fine-tuning of flow models requires effectively promoting high-reward and suppressing low-reward samples, while maintaining training stability over many rounds of iterative updates. Iterative reward fine-tuning provides a simple starting point, but the positive reward weights give no explicit unfitting signal, and repeated reweighting concentrates the distribution and causes collapse. We propose Stable Signed Flow Reinforcement (SIFR), which replaces the reward weights by signed advantages to supply the missing unfitting signal, and constrains the velocity drift from a reference model to stabilize the updates, with a Lagrange multiplier that adapts the regularization strength to a prescribed drift budget. We further show that existing flow RL methods fall within this framework: they implicitly minimize the signed loss, differing in their regularization choices. We validate SIFR on SD3.5 Medium (2.5B) and FLUX.2 Klein (9B) and scale it to Cosmos 3 Super Text2Image (64B): across all 12 backbone--reward pairs with preference and rule-based rewards, it matches or exceeds existing methods, reaches their peak rewards much faster, and keeps improving over long training where they plateau or collapse.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 SIFR，用带符号优势替代奖励权重为 flow 模型提供负向信号，并以速度漂移正则和自适应 Lagrange 乘子稳定多轮奖励微调，在多个文本到图像骨干上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究的是文本到图像 flow 模型的强化学习微调稳定性，不涉及视觉推理中的 latent 状态、证据获取或停止决策，缺少可核查的具体借鉴线索。
